answers.core: This should be core because organizing export vars is something that should be inherent to the workflow of creating a game. I think that it's a natural desire for a developer to organize things into things, and when you have a script that contains many many variables you start to feel the need to organize them, in the same way that we organize our project file structure, we organize our nodes...etc.
answers.workaround: Based on the documentation, it seems to me like it can be worked around but not with a few lines of script. Also, the documentation does not explain clearly how to do it, in my opinion.

title: C#: Add an easy and accessible way of organizing export variables
